senses.gloss:
निणिज् नि-णिज्, क् (according to Sāy. fr. नि-
निज्, to purify), milk; (according to modern scholars
this word may be an adverb related to नि-ण्य.)

निण्डिका निण्डिका, f. a species of convol-
vulus, = तिण्डी; (probably wrongly for तिण्डिका.)

निण्य नि-ण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि), Ved. in-
terior, hidden, concealed, secret, mysterious, (in
Ṛg-veda 1. 32, 10, = निर्-नामधेय, nameless,
according to Sāy.); (अम्), n. a secret, a mystery;
(अम्), ind. secretly, mysteriously.
